messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites MS C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
long long n, x, y;
long long gcd(long long a, long long b)
{
	while(b)
	{
		a %= b;
		swap(a,b);
	}
	return a;
}
struct dro
{
	long long ch;
	long long zn;
	dro()
	{}
	dro(long long a, long long b)
	{
		ch = a;
		zn = b;
	}
	void operator - (const dro &a)
	{
		ch = ch * a.zn - a.ch * zn;
		zn = zn * a.zn;
	}
	bool operator < (const dro &a) const
	{
		if (ch * a.zn < a.ch * zn)
			return true;
		else
			return false;
	}
	void cok()
	{
		long long j = gcd(ch, zn);
		ch /= j;
		zn /= j;
	}
	void sho()
	{
		cout << ch << "/" << zn;
	}
};
struct dro2
{
	long long ch;
	long long zn;
	dro2()
	{}
	dro2(long long a, long long b)
	{
		ch = a;
		zn = b;
	}
};
int main ()
{
	cin >> x >> y >> n;
	dro os(50, 1);
	dro na(x, y), ot;
	vector<dro2> v;
	for (long long i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
	{
		dro p;
		long long r = (na.ch * i) / na.zn;
		long long z = (na.ch * i) % na.zn;
		if (z > (na.zn / 2))
			r++, z = na.zn - z;
		p.ch = z;
		p.zn = i * na.zn;
		if (p < os)
		{	
			os = p;
			ot.ch = r;
			ot.zn = i;
		}
		v.push_back(dro2(z, i * na.zn));
	}
	for (auto it = v.rbegin(); it != v.rend(); ++it)
	{
		if (it->ch < os.ch)
		{
			os = dro(it->ch, it->zn);
			ot.ch = it->zn / it->ch;
		}
	}
	ot.sho();
}
</perturbed_code_1>
